leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue component that uses the `onMounted` hook to execute side effects after DOM rendering
Configure a Vue component with the `onUpdated` hook to handle state changes and DOM updates
Construct a component that uses the `watchEffect` function to reactively run side effects based on reactive dependencies
Apply the `nextTick` utility to schedule code execution after the next DOM update cycle
Manipulate DOM elements directly within lifecycle hooks to observe rendering timing differences
Integrate multiple lifecycle hooks in a single component to demonstrate execution order and timing
Initialize reactive state variables and bind them to DOM elements to visualize rendering effects
